httpHeaderAuth.name: WhatsApp Cloud API - Green Chimp LT

parameters.query:
WITH datos AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS phone_number_id,
    $2::text AS wa_id,
    $3::text AS texto,
    $4::text AS usuario,
    $5::text AS message_id
), mensaje AS (
  INSERT INTO public.wa_mensajes
    (phone_number_id, wa_id, direccion, autor, tipo, texto, message_id, estado)
  SELECT phone_number_id, wa_id, 'out', usuario, 'text', texto, message_id, 'accepted'
  FROM datos
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
), conversacion AS (
  UPDATE public.wa_conversaciones c SET
    bot_activo = false,
    pausado_en = now(),
    pausado_por = d.usuario,
    ultimo_mensaje = now(),
    ultimo_texto = d.texto,
    actualizado_en = now()
  FROM datos d
  WHERE c.phone_number_id = d.phone_number_id AND c.wa_id = d.wa_id
  RETURNING c.phone_number_id, c.wa_id, c.nombre, c.crm_lead_id
), evento AS (
  INSERT INTO public.crm_eventos (phone_number_id, wa_id, tipo, payload)
  SELECT
    c.phone_number_id, c.wa_id, 'intervencion_humana',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'tipo', 'intervencion_humana',
      'timestamp', now(),
      'origen', 'portal_conversaciones',
      'contacto', jsonb_build_object(
        'wa_id', c.wa_id,
        'nombre', c.nombre,
        'phone_number_id', c.phone_number_id
      ),
      'actor', d.usuario,
      'crm_lead_id', c.crm_lead_id
    )
  FROM conversacion c CROSS JOIN datos d
)
SELECT message_id, usuario AS autor FROM datos;
